exposure: length of second stage of labor
cohort: Neonates born at the study institution between March 2012 and July 2019
finding: Brachial plexus injury can occur with or without shoulder dystocia and is often not causally related.
mod_finding: This study found that brachial plexus injury was not always causally related to shoulder dystocia, and that both can occur during vaginal delivery.
birth_weight: Lower birth weights were associated with brachial plexus injury without shoulder dystocia.
